items.description: Pedigree Online's dog database offers free pedigree reports and detailed ancestry for millions of dogs of all breeds and is completely open to the public. Disclaimer: Pedigree information contained at Pedigree Online is provided by others. While Pedigree Online believes the information to be accurate, it does not guarantee its accuracy and assumes no liability to anyone for error.

Laravel, known as a PHP framework for web artisans, offers an API to integrate web features into applications. Site configuration, cloud account, and private networking are resources provided by Laravel Forge. Other tools include Cashier to simplify billing and Socialite to authorize with Facebook and Twitter.
Free carpool matching service based on home location and work location.

Rolemance makes it easy to spice up your relationship with flirtatious texting. You each control the dialogue, intimacy and outcome with simple A and B choices. Start a rolemance from any phone, anytime you're in the mood.

Listagram is a way to browse the life of your friends through a series of pictures on Instagram. It searches the Instagram user's public photo archive from the URL of one photo and shows like Frickr's photostream.

The NCAA partnered with DonorsChoose.org for the NCAA's Fund the Future campaign (www.ncaa.org/fundthefuture) in support of K-12 school districts around the country. The campaign was supported by public service announcements aired on TV during the NCAA championships of March 2011, including the NCAA Division I Menâ€™s and Womenâ€™s Basketball Championships!
nthCaller allows you to run 'caller number --' contests from your computer. Just pick a number and the winning call will be transferred to your phone.
A computer shopping site that makes extensive use of Amazons AWS service. The site is customized to return the best matching products available, allows you to track product prices, and more.
Search, rate, and discuss skate spots, parks and shops in your neighborhood using Google Maps. Upload, watch and rate your favorite skate videos and photos.
The Alien's Wall lets you view all the pictures from a subreddit in a gallery format.
Creative use of GPS, mapping and Ajax technology to show the current location of buses in the University of Michigan area.
Are you always going to the same bar, club or restaurant and want to find something new that is similar to the one you like? Use wahili to find new but similar nightlife spots!
Jobs Tractor searches twitter for developer jobs, ignoring recruiters and jobs boards. Tweets are displayed based on your location

NCAA Mens Basketball Championship on Google Maps. Includes locations of Winners, Losers, Venue. History of the Championship games from 1939-Present. Many ways to search and sort including year, highest or lowest Score, nail biters, and widest margin.
DVDCrate: The online DVD cataloger and organizer. Track your viewings, share with friends, keep with with disc loans, manage your collection. Much more!

CandidateVerification is an online service that provides candidates (running for US office) with free background checks. Other individuals can have access to the database that has been researched and collected by CandidateVerification. It helps political candidates to promote themselves, and also help people to have a better idea of who their potential politicians are.

Zuora is an online company that provides services to businesses who want to sell their products/services via subscription. This application is integrated with DocuSign to enable its customers to electronically sign their documents.

A comprehensive guide for coastal activities using Google Maps and Facebook. Whether you are looking for a beach holiday, a day at the coast, a coastal path walk, tourist attractions or energetic sports activities, this site has the details.
Create your own maps and share with friends.

Map site dedicated to the island of Fuerteventura. The 'Share Your Location' feature allows users to create and position a labelled marker and copy its URL, a short URL, QR code, iframe HTML (plus embed code for Fuerteventura Forum)
Map for locating all kinds of playgrounds in Germany.

IndiaTweetz- Tweets and News about India- is a one stop Twitter based portal to tap the buzz in India.Tweets are categorized in groups like Headlines,Cricket,Politics,Business, Bollywood,Celebrities,Cities etc.
